h: The Consolation That No Soul Will Be Lost

p: סִיּוּם הַפְטוֹרָה דְּפָרָשָׁה זוֹ (יְשַׁעְיָה מ, כו)
The conclusion of the haftarah of this parsha (Yeshayahu 40:26):
and see Who created these," etc.
And in all six of the haftaros
it concludes with pesukim of consolation,
but here, by the plain meaning,
there is no consolation in it.
and it was completed in the Name Elokim," etc.
Now the matter of the consolation
that the whole intent of the exiles
is that from this will sprout
the spread of the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
as is written in the holy Zohar
And this is the meaning of
"on high" is the name of the attribute of Atika,
above the comprehension and grasp of people;
and the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh
is from the Dew of Atika,
hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
"And see Who — Mi — created these — eileh":
and from there is the beginning
the Written Torah and Torah she'b'al peh;
is what is plain to the eye,
which is like pointing with a finger;
and as is written in the holy Zohar
and from both of them is completed
down to the attribute of Malchus,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
And as is written in the holy Zohar
the order of the branching out
which is the aspect of Malchus,
"Who brings out their host by number":
that it is expounded about the souls of Yisrael.
the essential purpose of the exiles
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַכֹּחַ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
that through the power of Torah she'b'al peh,
all the souls of Yisrael will be rectified.
"Through the abundance of might and strength of power
This is according to what is written
"Let them be wiped out for the sanctification of Your Name";
who explained that they should be wiped out,
and the Name of Heaven be sanctified
and Yaakov, whose attribute is mercy?
"Let them be wiped out for the sanctification of Your Name
הַיְינוּ עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְשַׁעְיָה מג, כה)
that is, in the manner of what it says (Yeshayahu 43:25):
Who wipes out your transgressions for My sake";
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (יְחֶזְקֵאל לו, כ)
and in the manner of what it says (Yechezkel 36:20):
in that it was said of them:
These are the people of Hashem,
and they have gone out of His land";
for from this comes the desecration of the Name;
"But I had pity for My holy Name," etc.
And this is what they said,
"Let them be wiped out for the sanctification of Your Name"
that He atone for them their iniquities.
Therefore those who said this were
Avraham, who with his attribute of kindness
and likewise Yaakov, who with his attribute of mercy
"There is no reason in the elders
and no counsel in the young";
no person would have been executed," etc.,
and Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
all of them are upon me
I offered my soul before You";
and surely there is in them
for our will is to do Your will.
And this is what it says:
"Through the abundance of might and strength of power"
that none of them be cast away.
And this is the entire purpose of the exiles:
